title: The Totals row stays visible at the bottom while scrolling, the report fills the height, and only the active tab's table body scrolls
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. A tab has more rows than fit on the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Scroll the rows up and down and watch the Totals row.
2. Look at the page for a second scrollbar outside the table.
custom_expected:
1. The Totals row stays visible at the bottom while the rows scroll.
2. The report fills the available height and only the active tab's table body scrolls — the page itself does not add a second scrollbar.
